from qiskit import QuantumCircuit


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # X^{\otimes n} ( -1 on |11..1> ) X^{\otimes n}
    # = diag(-1, +1, +1, ...) which is the desired operator up to global phase
    qc.x(range(n))
    qc.h(n - 1)
    qc.mcx(list(range(n - 1)), n - 1)
    qc.h(n - 1)
    qc.x(range(n))
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import DiagonalGate


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # diag[0] = 1, diag[i>0] = -1  ->  2|0...0><0...0| - I
    dim = 1 << n
    diag = [1] + [-1] * (dim - 1)
    qc.append(DiagonalGate(diag), range(n))
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # map |0...0> <-> |1...1>
    qc.x(range(n))
    # multi-controlled Z = phase -1 on |1...1>
    qc.mcz(range(n))
    # undo the basis change
    qc.x(range(n))
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math

def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # |0...0> -> |1...1>
    qc.x(range(n))
    # multi-controlled phase pi = -1 on |1...1>
    # mcp(theta, controls, target)
    qc.mcp(math.pi, list(range(n - 1)), n - 1)
    # undo basis change
    qc.x(range(n))
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import MCPhaseGate
import numpy as np


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # flip the computational basis so that |0…0> becomes |1…1>
    qc.x(range(n))
    # multi-controlled phase π on the last qubit
    # after the basis change this is a phase flip on |1…1>
    gate = MCPhaseGate(np.pi, num_ctrl_qubits=n - 1)
    qc.append(gate, range(n))
    # undo the basis change
    qc.x(range(n))
    return qc
